lines.t: Huh?
Is everything okay over there now?
{{exploration_club_pres_kunigiku}}
It was so popular it never ended, so we
just handed them out with no {{robattle|pl}}.
{{main}}

I handed out passwords to exactly 128
people!
Wow~.
Thanks for your hard work.
I wonder if everyone will use them.
{{ryoma}}
Maybe they'll forget by tomorrow.
Like a prize won at a night stall.
{{exploration_club_pres_kunigiku}}
What a romantic thing to say.
Well, at least we've built a track record.
I'm fine either way.
That should keep us going for a while.
I feel like I heard that
pretty recently--
